_meta.title: UNET
_meta.note: FLUX.2 klein 4B GGUF Q4_K_M (~2.6GB) -- the design-permitted 8GB-VRAM fallback (replaces flux1-schnell per 2026-08 swap). The ComfyClient ban-check reads unet_name here.

_meta.title: CLIP
_meta.note: FLUX.2 klein uses the Qwen3-4B text encoder (qwen_3_4b.safetensors) with CLIPLoader type 'flux2' -- NOT the flux1 clip_l/t5xxl pair. Matches the official ComfyUI klein template.

_meta.title: VAE
_meta.note: FLUX.2 VAE (flux2-vae.safetensors), 128-channel latent -- klein does not use the flux1 ae.safetensors.

_meta.title: PROMPT_POS
_meta.note: The assembled sd_prompt lands here (patched per shot by ComfyClient: character anchors + location anchor + composition + style tail, 120-word budget).

_meta.title: PROMPT_NEG
_meta.note: Real negative conditioning for the CFGGuider (klein runs cfg 5.0, unlike flux1-schnell's cfg 1.0 where the negative was ignored).

inputs.text: blurry, low quality, low contrast, flat, washed out, dark, underexposed, noise, grain, oversaturated, cartoon, childish, ugly, text, watermark, signature, extra limbs, deformed

_meta.title: LATENT
_meta.note: Blank 128-channel FLUX.2 latent canvas. Patched to 1216x704 for panels/plates, 832x1216 portrait for character refs. WIDTH/HEIGHT also patch Flux2Scheduler (15) so its resolution-dependent sigma schedule stays in sync.

_meta.title: SCHED
_meta.note: FLUX.2 resolution-dependent sigma schedule. steps 20, cfg 5.0, euler -- the official klein text-to-image recipe.

_meta.title: SAVE
_meta.note: Writes the PNG under ComfyUI/output/<SAVE_PREFIX>; ComfyClient then copies it into the project's panels/refs directory and renames it deterministically.

_meta.title: SAMPLER
_meta.note: euler sampler for the klein recipe.

_meta.title: GUIDER
_meta.note: CFG 5.0 per the official klein template (cfg is patched via the CFG title; stages that only patch PROMPT_POS/SEED/etc. leave it at the default).

_meta.title: SAMPLER_ADV
_meta.note: Wires noise + guider + sampler + sigmas + latent into the denoising loop.

_meta.title: DECODE
_meta.note: 128-channel latent -> RGB via the FLUX.2 VAE from node 3.
